title: skills: project-setup.md's CLI table still lists `objectui add` and `analyze`'s render-performance mode, both retired by objectui#11496
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a shipped-surface sentence that will be wrong after a landing, with a named location.

`reach:` a named real producer. `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` belongs to the shipped `objectui` skill, which agents setting up an objectui project read. Its CLI table teaches two surfaces that PR objectui#11499 (objectui#11496, triage ruling `5958245941`) retires:
- `:174` `| \`objectui add\` | Add a component renderer scaffold |`. After the landing, the built CLI refuses `add` as an unknown command (exit 1).
- `:177` `| \`objectui analyze\` | Analyze bundle size / render performance |`. After the landing, `analyze` prints only the bundle-size report, and `--render-performance` / `--bundle-size` are refused as unknown options.

Found by the at-tier contract reviewer of PR objectui#11499 (record `5959693747`, ③), and not named by the dev or the seat. `skills/**` is a governed surface (`GOVERNED_SURFACES` id `skills-catalog`), so it rightly could not ride the code PR. The seat grepped all of `skills/` for every CLI surface retired today: `add`, `analyze`'s two flags, and `generate --output` / `--from` (objectui#11476, objectui#11488). These two rows are the only hits.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)
Delete row `:174`. Reword row `:177` to what `analyze` does: the bundle-size report of `dist/`. Nothing else in the table changes. The precedent for edits to this guide's CLI table is objectui#10526.

Pin: a grep over `skills/objectui/**` finds no `objectui add` and no `render performance`.

Reader who acts: the objectui `domain:skills` seat (seat post objectui#11311), as objectui#11471 was routed. It lands by human approval, in its own PR. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Dedupe
- REST scan of the 900 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed: `project-setup` gives 5 hits, all closed and about other rows or other guides (objectui#10526: the `objectui check` row; objectui#11011 / PR objectui#11316: `ObjectView`; PR objectui#11404; PR objectui#10930). None is about `add` or `analyze`.
- objectui#11471 (open, `domain:skills`) is the sibling for `protocol.md`'s `responsive-grid` and a different file. Triage may fold the two into one skills PR.

Dedupe words: `project-setup.md objectui add` · `skills CLI table analyze render performance` · `objectui#11496 skills guide`
